judgment.notes: A001 uses exactly E004's equivalent twisted-step identity. Positivity, nonnegative step start and smooth mean-zero input are available before application. Routine regularity and calculus applications have smooth inputs and finite compact time intervals.

Induction and S_{-t_n} give the same properties for v^n. E004 yields the stated endpoint update; substituting W_n cancels Q_n at the right endpoint. Stepwise differentiation and symmetry of B give all three derivative formulas, with Y_n(t_n)=0. E004 also identifies R2 on smooth inputs as f+F_n+C_n-S_{-(t_n+tau)}Psi_tau(S_{t_n}f), a smooth quantity; no bounded extension to rough data is needed.
